Q8247.reason: Effective vaccines for the tropical diseases that blocked the African interior did not exist in 1750–1900, whereas the Maxim gun, steamships, and chartered joint-stock companies all aided penetration.

Q8248.reason: Humans occupy Arctic-to-tropics ranges mainly through intelligence, technology, and culture, not habitat-by-habitat biological evolution or racial genetics.

Q8255.reason: NASA’s Phoenix Mars Lander touched down on 25 May 2008 and used its robotic arm to trench into ice-rich arctic soil.

Q8256.reason: The Qur’an forbids drink, gambling, and idols, while Khayyam’s wine verse sits against that same religious rule of personal conduct.
